title: Mixe–Zoque languages - Wikipedia
text: The Mexican government recognizes three distinct Mixe–Zoquean languages as official: Mixe or ayook with 188,000 speakers, Zoque or o'de püt with 88,000 speakers, and the Popoluca languages of which some are Mixean and some Zoquean with 69,000 speakers.

title: Mixe languages
text: The Mixe languages, part of the Mixe-Zoquean family, are primarily spoken by an estimated 136,762 individuals aged 5 years and older in Mexico according to the 2020 national census, with the vast majority—over 85%—concentrated in the state of Oaxaca.
